paper.title_en: Time Direction Entanglement Entropy of Free Fermion Ground States
paper.abstract_en: While the entanglement entropy of a spatial subregion has been extensively studied, a properly defined entanglement entropy of quantum states in a time direction interval remains underexplored. We investigate the scaling behaviors of the recently defined time direction entanglement entropy (TDEE) for free fermion quantum states, which is computed from the reduced density matrix of a sub-Hilbert space that minimally supports all the time-evolved operators in the time direction interval. Based on the Fisher--Hartwig conjecture for Toeplitz matrices, we develop an analytical framework for understanding the TDEE in a time interval with discrete time step $τ$. For disorderless one-dimensional (1D) systems (gapless fermions or band insulators), in different regimes of gap, bandwidth and $τ$, we find the TDEE can exhibit area law (for nonzero gap), logarithmic law or volume law in the length of time. For 1D Anderson insulators, we numerically find the TDEE shows a Page-curve like behavior, growing at short time, and decaying in power-law at long time exceeding the crossover time determined by localization. In the continuum time limit $τ\rightarrow 0$, the TDEE of disorderless gapless fermions, band insulators and Anderson insulators exhibit logarithmic law, area law and sub-area law, respectively. We also show that the sub-Hilbert space of a time-direction interval stabilizes in the $τ\rightarrow 0$ limit, which is understandable as a subspace of the Hilbert space of the Lieb-Robinson causal diamond.

decision.reject_reason_zh: 该论文研究的是自由费米子基态的时间方向纠缠熵（TDEE），属于量子信息与凝聚态/量子场论交叉的纠缠熵课题，不涉及度规-仿射引力、Palatini引力或修改引力等目标主题，也不涉及黑洞热力学或PTA。对引力索引而言相关性不足。
decision.title_zh: 自由费米子基态的时间方向纠缠熵
decision.abstract_zh: 尽管空间子区域的纠缠熵已被广泛研究，但时间方向区间上量子态的、定义恰当的纠缠熵仍研究不足。我们研究了最近定义的时间方向纠缠熵（TDEE）在自由费米子量子态中的标度行为，该熵由最小支撑时间方向区间内所有时间演化算符的子希尔伯特空间的约化密度矩阵计算得到。基于 Toeplitz 矩阵的 Fisher--Hartwig 猜想，我们建立了理解具有离散时间步长 $\tau$ 的时间区间内 TDEE 的解析框架。对于无序的一维（1D）系统（无能隙费米子或能带绝缘体），在能隙、带宽与 $\tau$ 的不同参数区域中，我们发现 TDEE 可以表现出关于时间长度的面积律（对应非零能隙）、对数律或体积律。对于一维 Anderson 绝缘体，我们通过数值计算发现 TDEE 呈现类 Page 曲线行为：在短时间增长，而在超过由局域化决定的交叉时间后长时间以幂律衰减。在连续时间极限 $\tau\rightarrow 0$ 下，无序无能隙费米子、能带绝缘体和 Anderson 绝缘体的 TDEE 分别表现出对数律、面积律和次面积律。我们还表明，时间方向区间的子希尔伯特空间在 $\tau\rightarrow 0$ 极限下稳定下来，这可以理解为 Lieb-Robinson 因果菱形的希尔伯特空间的一个子空间。
